title: The Red List
summary: The Camarilla's most hunted Anathema, all under Blood Hunt.

claims.text: The book presents some of the most cunning and dangerous Kindred ever placed under a Blood Hunt.
Not every Kindred on the list is guilty.

title: Angelo, the Blood Brother
summary: A Los Angeles gang leader brought into the Sabbat.

claims.text: During the 1966 riots in Los Angeles, after the Sabbat siege of the city, a nomad Sabbat pack watched a mortal gang led by a young drug-fuelled man named Angelo burn building after building.

title: Rabbat
summary: An ancient Kindred whose mortal life ended in the Mongol conquest of China.

claims.text: Rabbat was already old when Genghis Khan's horde swept through the Chin Empire in the early 13th century, wiping out town after town in two years.
Rabbat survived the massacres and was taken captive by the Mongols.

title: Genina
summary: A former slave from the Ashanti, taken to the Caribbean.

claims.text: Genina was born into the Ashanti of West Africa in the mid 17th century and taken by Portuguese slavers at the age of five.
Sold in Jamaica and later moved to Haiti, Genina worked the sugar fields of the Cul-de-Sac Plain.
Around 2200 BC the Gangrel Antediluvian returned to Ur and raised a ziggurat to the moon that became a haven for the clan.
Enkidu was born to a poor family in a village outside the city.

title: Ossian
summary: A Kindred who was once a Fianna Galliard, born of a fae mother.

claims.text: Five hundred years ago Ossian was a Fianna Garou, a recorder and poet of the tribe.
Ossian's mother Sadhbh was one of the Seelie fae, turned into a fawn by the mage Fear Doirche and later freed by the Garou.

title: Dylan
summary: A Kindred whose story began in the London Blitz.

claims.text: On the night of October 10, 1940, bombs fell across more than 50 districts of London, while Dylan Bee sheltered in a trench by the Thames.

title: Ferox
summary: A Kindred born to the Iceni in the age of Boudicca.

claims.text: Ferox was a secret child of Queen Boudicca of the Iceni by a commoner, kept hidden from King Prasutagus.
Prasutagus, a client king of Rome, left half of the kingdom's wealth to Nero.

title: Alexis Danpai
summary: A Russian noble of the age of Peter the Great.

claims.text: Alexis was born to a rich Russian family favoured by the tsar at the start of the 18th century and was chosen to study abroad under Peter the Great.

title: Germaine
summary: A Kindred caught up in the French Revolution.

claims.text: When Louis XVI took the throne in 1774, the Toreador of the French court backed the status quo against reform.

title: Tariq
summary: A Bedouin warrior who joined the Assamites.

claims.text: During the Seventh Crusade Tariq defended the Saracen city of Mansourah.
Tariq later gave service to the Old Man of the Mountain.

title: Valerius Maior
summary: A Roman soldier from the war against Antony and Cleopatra.

claims.text: Valerius served in one of the 19 legions that went over to Agrippa after the battle of Actium in 31 BC.

title: Petaniqua
summary: A princess of Epirus drawn to the cult of Cybele.

claims.text: Born a princess of Epirus under Macedonian sway, Petaniqua went looking for secret lore and joined the cult of Cybele on Samothrace, where Philip of Macedon was met.

title: Kemintiri
summary: A Setite tied to the war between the cult of Isis and the Followers of Set.

claims.text: After Isis died, the cult of Isis, keepers of the Spell of Life, mourned for centuries until Horus rose again as a mummy.
The cult helped Horus destroy the Followers of Set across Egypt but feared Set's revenge.
